## otp-vault 0.1.0: the first release

Your two-factor codes on Windows in an encrypted vault: a window with all codes, a tray icon, import from nearly every authenticator app, export and printed recovery sheets.

- **New:** codes for TOTP, HOTP and Steam with countdown ring and next code; click copies, the clipboard is cleared after 30 seconds and kept out of the Windows clipboard history.
- **New:** import of secrets, `otpauth://` links, Google Authenticator export QR codes, Aegis, 2FAS, andOTP, Bitwarden, KeePassXC CSV and otp-vault backups, also from QR code images and pasted screenshots.
- **New:** export as encrypted backup, A4 recovery sheet (PDF) with QR codes, Google Authenticator QR codes, Aegis JSON, `otpauth://` links and CSV.
- **New:** master password with Argon2id and XChaCha20-Poly1305, auto lock, lock with Windows, tray icon, start with Windows, icons on request, German and English.

The files are not digitally signed yet; Windows SmartScreen may warn. Every file is built by GitHub Actions from this repository, and `SHA256SUMS.txt` lists their checksums.
